009c4f03-b7c3-59c5-9e9a-a538e040c296.title: Neven Maguire's turkey, rocket and pine nut pasta
instructions: Put the wholemeal pasta in a large pan of boiling, salted water and cook for about 10 minutes until ‘al dente’ - cooked but still firm
Heat a frying pan over a medium heat and add the pine nuts. Gently cook for a few minutes until lightly toasted, tossing occasionally to prevent them from burning. Tip into a bowl and set aside
Add ¾ tablespoon of oil to the frying pan and sauté the mushrooms, onion, garlic and thyme for 2 to 3 minutes until softened and just beginning to colour
Stir in the mustard, turkey, crème fraiche and then bring to a gentle simmer
Cook for 1 minute to just heat through but don’t allow the mixture to boil!

Drain the pasta and quickly refresh in cold water for a few seconds to prevent it from cooking any more, then return to the pan. Pour in the creamy turkey mixture and add the chopped rocket and basil. Toss lightly together to combine and season to taste
To serve, spoon the pasta on to warmed serving plates and then sprinkle over the toasted pine nuts and garnish with some Parmesan shavings

benefit.tip: Wholemeal pasta and less oil keep the dish just as hearty while the dish has 38% more fibre per serving.

02eb89b9-77d9-423f-9b5c-aaeba0c53e73.title: Lamb on skewers
instructions: Clean lamb, cut into pieces, rub with salt, pepper, thyme, bay leaf, lemon juice, and oil; marinate ~12 hours. Skewer and grill until golden, splashing with wine while grilling.

benefit.tip: Using less olive oil: the dish has 11% less saturated fat per serving.

051f296b-f373-53a3-9ea1-664322afc60c.title: Spinach and mandarin salad
instructions: Fresh spinach is notoriously dirty. Bacteria such as E. coli and Listeria are commonly found in soil, so carefully wash the spinach by first soaking the leaves in a clean sink filled with cold water.
After swishing the leaves around in the water, take out only one or two pieces at a time, making sure that there is no remaining soil clinging to them.
Tear the leaves into bite-sized pieces
Combine the spinach and mandarin oranges in a salad bowl
In a small mixing bowl, combine the vinegar, water, olive oil and honey
Beat with a whisk and mix into spinach and oranges
Once washed and sliced, fry the red onion slices in vegetable oil until they are browned and soft, then mix them into the rest of the salad while still hot
Toast the almonds and mix them into the salad while still hot

benefit.tip: Reducing the olive oil and honey: the dish has 16% less saturated fat per serving.

08ff1b57-ad12-5814-a100-d7ffe45b2418.title: Nutty Veggie Couscous
instructions: Place the couscous in a bowl with 200ml / 7 fl oz. hot stock. Leave for 5 minutes and break up the lumps with a fork
Drain the chickpeas and chop the apricots and nuts
Add the remaining hot stock, chickpeas, chopped apricots and nuts to the bowl
Heat the oil in a frying pan and stir-fry the leftover vegetables until piping hot, then add to the couscous
Finely chop the fresh herbs and add to the bowl just before serving
Season to taste

benefit.tip: Using boiled chickpeas and less olive oil: the dish has 36% less salt per serving.

0a99a224-3378-56d8-8407-4cf0a6f1920f.title: Sage and breadcrumb stuffing
instructions: Make breadcrumbs by rubbing the bread slices against the grater, or if you have a food processor then blend until small bread crumbs are created
Chop the onion and garlic finely. Melt the butter in a pan, add the onion and garlic and cook until soft but not brown. Remove from the heat
Add the breadcrumbs and sage. Add a little salt and ground black pepper
Use mixture to stuff into the cavity turkey before roasting.

benefit.tip: Using rapeseed oil and less vegetable oil: the Nutri-Score improves from C to A and the dish has 78% less saturated fat per serving.

0b4a8093-3b37-4d28-823b-69e7a8a47a1c.title: Chicory with bean

instructions: Wash and slice radicchio, add cooked beans, salt, oil, and vinegar; mix and serve.

0c7814ae-56bf-5302-96c1-0bb9149a4ff0.title: Pasta with salmon and peas
instructions: Half-fill a large saucepan with water and bring to the boil
Cook the pasta until firm, not too soft - the packet should have cooking times
While that’s cooking, cut the salmon into cubes
Heat the olive oil in a frying pan, and then add the salmon
Cook the fish for around 5 minutes – it should change colour but not go brown
Add the peas, crème fraiche and parsley to the pan and cook for a further 2 minutes
Add the pepper and lemon juice; check according to taste. When the pasta is cooked, tip out all the water, and then add it to the pan with the sauce
Toss the spaghetti lightly in the sauce, then serve straight away

benefit.tip: Wholewheat pasta: the dish has 41% more fibre per serving.

0de4551a-09c5-425a-b0af-f4bbbb5bc26c.title: Beef soup

0f9e7c0f-ab0a-4c45-b6b1-48585043b5e7.title: Chanterelles with eggs
instructions: Clean and slice mushrooms. Sauté onion in butter until translucent, add chanterelles and fry on high heat 15–20 minutes. After 10 minutes add salt, pepper, and beaten eggs with the yoghurt. Stir occasionally. Serve with parsley.

benefit.tip: Greek yoghurt: the dish has 42% less saturated fat per serving.

10617a7b-622b-5428-8ec0-3f8ee62229d4.title: Brown bread ice cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C / 400°F / Gas mark 6
Leave the breadcrumbs to dry out in the oven for around 15 minutes or so
Mix the sugar in with the breadcrumbs and bring back to the oven for another 15 minutes
Remove from the oven, allow the mix to cool
Crush the sweetened crumbs together with the back of a spoon
Separate the egg yolks from the whites
Beat the yolks and mix in with the cream, vanilla essence and the crumb mix
Whisk the egg whites until they are slightly stiff
Fold the whites into the mix and freeze in an airtight plastic container

benefit.tip: Using less sugar: the dish has 21% less sugar per serving.

10a4d044-81b4-5958-b14e-fb0e4e523d5f.title: Tuna pasta bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C / 350°F / Gas Mark 4
Bring pasta to the boil and cook following the instructions on the packet, approximately 13 minutes. Drain water once cooked
Flake the tuna into a bowl and add the chopped onion, Worcestershire sauce, salt if using, pepper and pasta
Pour some of the mixture from step 3 into a casserole dish and cover with a layer of breadcrumbs
Continue layering in this way until all ingredients have been used up
Finish with a layer of breadcrumbs on the top, dot the surface with the low-fat spread and bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes
Serve immediately

benefit.tip: Wholewheat pasta: the dish has 48% more fibre per serving.

1286f90a-5326-5768-8b4f-af415de99f69.title: Fruit Crumble
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C/350°F/gas mark 4.
In a small bowl, mix together the oats, flour, and cinnamon. Add in the agave syrup or honey and butter, mixing until completely incorporated.
In another bowl, toss together the berries, cornflour, and vanilla extract until thoroughly combined.
Spread the berry mixture in a tin or casserole dish, and evenly sprinkle the oat crumbs on top.
Bake for 35 to 45 minutes, or until the berry juice is bubbling and the oat mixture crunchy.
Allow to cool slightly, divide into bowls and serve.

benefit.tip: Using less agave syrup or honey: the dish has 14% less sugar per serving.

128a007b-cb48-5f98-8435-1e2dd6457834.title: Hot pasta salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to packet instructions.
Place the mayonnaise and lemon juice into a large bowl and mix.
Place the tuna into the same bowl and mix well.
Slice the peppers and onion thinly and add to the large bowl.
Drain the pasta and mix in with the mayonnaise mixture.
Serve with a handful of rocket.

benefit.tip: Wholewheat pasta and less mayonnaise keep the salad just as hearty while the dish has 55% more fibre per serving.

1448e270-4fa3-5793-84f2-926aa109934d.title: Queen cakes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C / 400°F / Gas Mark 6.
Sieve the flour into a bowl.
Beat the margarine and sugar together in a separate bowl with a wooden spoon or electric mixer.
Beat the eggs in a small bowl.
Add the flour and eggs gradually to the creamed margarine and sugar, mixing gently to avoid curdling.
If the mixture is dry add a little milk.
Divide the mixture into bun cases.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.

benefit.tip: Reducing the sugar: the dish has 24% less sugar per serving.

17a1357b-b7d2-5ea1-a51d-cdafd961e062.title: Leftover turkey curry
instructions: Pre-heat the oven to 180°C / 350°F / Gas Mark 4
Cut meat into one-inch pieces
Fry the meat, onion and garlic over a low heat until the meat is brown on all sides
Then place in a casserole dish
Stir in the flour and curry powder to the juices remaining in the pan
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes
Add the stock and grated apple. Stir continuously to avoid lumps
Bring to the boil and add to the meat mixture in casserole
Cook in the pre-heated oven for 1½ hours until meat is tender

notes.text: Turkey is leaner than lamb and cooks faster: cook until just done and check early, because it dries out if overcooked.

1bcfa204-c186-5aaf-a1dc-e48b8d71e375.title: Barmbrack
instructions: Add the fruit and sugar to a bowl, cover with the tea and leave to soak overnight. The tea should just about cover all the fruit
When you are ready to bake, heat your oven to 150oC (300oF) or gas mark 2 and prepare and line a 1lb loaf tin
Add the egg and flour to the fruit and mix. If the mixture is a little dry, add a little more tea until the consistency is that of a fruit cake mix
Pour into the prepared tin and transfer to the oven
Bake for 1 hour, checking the cake is cooked before removing from the oven

benefit.tip: Reducing the sugar: the dish has 6% less sugar per serving.

1c38da95-43a0-5574-b801-20e125cd17fb.title: Roast potatoes
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C / 400°F / Gas Mark 6.
Peel the potatoes, cut them into quarters and place in a saucepan.
Boil water in the kettle and cover the potatoes with boiling water.
Place 1 ½ tablespoons of oil in the roasting tin and set it in the hot oven to heat.
Bring the potatoes to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat, drain off the water into a bowl and then set the potatoes back on the hob.
Holding the lid firmly on the saucepan, shake the saucepan up and down so that the potatoes move around and their outsides get a bit bashed.
Lift the roasting tin with the hot oil out of the oven and set on top of the cooker.
Add the potatoes one by one to the hot oil - be careful! Brush or spoon the oil over the surface of the potatoes.
Place the potatoes back in the oven and cook for another 15 minutes.
Turn the potatoes over and cook for another 15 minutes.
Test with a skewer to make sure the potatoes are cooked. You should have potatoes that are crunchy on the outside and soft inside.

benefit.tip: Using less oil: the dish has 25% less saturated fat per serving.

1c53a9ab-4415-5d01-b447-0d6d40c8c29e.title: Tomato and onion relish
instructions: Heat the oil in a pan
Sauté the tomato and onion for two minutes, to soften
Add the chilli flakes and coriander and stir well
Pour in the red wine, vinegar, ketchup and water and bring to the boil
Reduce the heat and simmer gently for 8 to 10 minutes, adding any extra water if necessary
Cover and store in the fridge. Use within three days

benefit.tip: Using less oil: the dish has 24% less saturated fat per serving.

1d95be06-ddfa-522a-9ba3-b0a9343a64a8.title: Roasted vegetable pasta

ingredient_lines.new: 1 ⅛ tbsp olive oil or rapeseed oil

Stir before serving
Optional: Grated parmesan to serve

benefit.tip: Wholewheat pasta and less oil and sugar keep the dish just as hearty while the dish has 32% more fibre per serving.

1fdb7597-d963-5d96-9691-8b7b58d1dc64.title: Roast turkey breast with garlic and herbs

ingredient_lines.old: 1 boneless half leg of lamb, trimmed - around 1½ kg / 3½lb

instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C / 350°F / Gas Mark 4

Set the mixture aside. If you don’t have a food processor, just finely chop everything with a knife
Place the joint in a roasting pan with the onion and water, put in the oven and allow 20 to 25 minutes per ½kg / 1lb
30 minutes before the end of cooking time remove from the oven; spread the herby mixture over the joint. Return to the oven and finish cooking
Keep an eye on the water level and top it up if necessary
When the turkey is cooked remove from the pan and keep warm. Discard the onion and remove excess fat
Boil up the pan juices and reduce to a syrup, this will make a rich, tasty sauce. This will take 2 to 3 minutes
Season and serve

20444379-9223-43e6-9cb6-9cf548b2fea3.title: Honey apples

2050ac79-fd2b-56ce-969e-a88ab4a346ff.title: Beef chilli con carne soup
instructions: If you are using leftovers from our beef chilli con carne recipe, add the leftovers to a saucepan, then add 200g / 7oz. of tomatoes and 500ml / ½ pint of water. Then skip to step 9
Chop the onion, garlic, carrot, pepper and mushrooms
Dissolve beef cubes in a 1650ml / 1/41 1/2 pint of boiling water
Put beef mince, extra lean in dry frying pan. There is sufficient fat in mince for frying
Cook for 20 to 25 minutes over a low heat until well browned, stirring all the time
Add onions and garlic to the pan and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Sprinkle on the flour and chilli powder and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring all the time
Add beef stock, tomato sauce, tinned tomatoes and vegetables. Bring to the boil
Add kidney beans to mince
Simmer for 20 minutes or until the sauce is at the desired consistency

benefit.tip: Extra lean beef mince: the dish has 63% less saturated fat per serving.

20c2c7f4-d103-46fb-b966-30a1f255832f.title: Wheat žganci

214df3cb-6ec4-53ee-b686-bd2535a7fe20.title: BLT pasta salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to the pack instructions.

benefit.tip: Wholewheat pasta: the dish has 31% more fibre per serving.

232dec15-3991-44bf-802f-7771a87e4c41.title: Zucchini stuffed with beef
instructions: Wash zucchini, remove stem, halve and remove seeds. Salt, place in a greased pan and fill with meat stuffing. Mix soaked bread pieces into the meat stuffing, cool, then add eggs, sour cream and parsley. Sprinkle stuffed zucchini with cheese and bake 35 minutes at 180°C.

benefit.tip: Cottage cheese: the dish has 31% less saturated fat per serving.

236785a3-5cea-4b2d-9f4a-16191a875561.title: Asparagus frittata

264f0666-8ef4-4cd8-ada7-b544631c77ad.title: Lasagna

26fa2b97-7638-5b7c-b774-b831989eb2ef.title: Banana and walnut loaf
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C / 350°F / Gas mark 4
Beat the egg and add to the margarine and sugar in a large mixing bowl
Sift in the flour
Whisk the mixture quickly
In a separate bowl, mash the bananas with a fork
Add the bananas and the walnuts and mix again
Put the dough into a loaf tin and smooth off the top
Bake the loaf in the middle of the oven for just under an hour

272dd01c-3f29-5745-83d9-540a70871b4b.title: Beef chilli con carne

Peel and crush or finely dice the garlic and slice the mushrooms.

benefit.tip: Brown basmati rice: the dish has 11% more fibre per serving.

2c192a1f-a737-5fbd-82d3-6f011c3464f1.title: Apple and berry crumble
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180˚C/350˚F/Gas mark 4

To make the crumble topping, mix together the oats and cinnamon in a small bowl
Make a well in the centre and pour in the maple syrup and low-fat butter. Stir until fully combined.
Crumble the topping over the fruit mixture to cover in an even layer

benefit.tip: Using less maple syrup: the dish has 9% less sugar per serving.

2c8ed38a-4f89-5c68-b43f-3199894a2a57.title: Simple sponge cake

When the sponges have cooled, spread the jam and put the sponges together.
Using a sieve, dust the top with icing sugar.

2d42c40b-6760-5b0b-80e8-6fd0d21532b6.title: Pork and vegetable noodle stir fry
instructions: Finely peel and chop the garlic, ginger, and onion. Then slice the pepper and carrot into thin strips and chop the mushrooms
Slice the pork into bitesize pieces
Heat the oil in a pan and fry the pork until browned
Add the garlic, ginger and onion to the pan and fry for 2 minutes
Then add the carrot, peppers and mushrooms to the pan and fry for another 2 to 3 minutes
Meanwhile cook the noodles according to the instructions on the packet

Serve with the cooked noodles

2e48d6c8-1ede-5873-b75f-7b072ab4fe60.title: Apple sponge squares

Cut into squares when cooled

2f076ea7-d0ec-4434-aed2-f5da26458ff2.title: Crêpes with curd cheese, gratinated

37fcdf86-2308-514d-b515-e5d6586da2f1.title: Spicy scrambled eggs

Pour the mixture into the heated pan and mix gently until it is cooked enough for you

3ab08b82-c981-4bcc-b17c-498c25908cf7.title: Slovenian rolled dumplings (štruklji) with tarragon

3c4b19b1-739c-5cc3-bf9c-aca98a582177.title: Chicken casserole

41d2e26d-8d41-5114-9fda-02a5d214923c.title: Pizza

42e58dbf-8c3a-5df5-ac77-16e77d62f7cf.title: Penne with tomato and ricotta
instructions: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over a medium heat and add the chilli and garlic.

Place all the ingredients into a pot with a lid and bring to the boil rapidly

492ffc2b-7e22-573c-aed9-57f5c8592710.title: Chicken and ginger curry with fragrant rice
instructions: Heat a small saucepan over a medium heat and toast the coriander, cumin and mustard seeds for 20 seconds until they become fragrant and begin to pop.

Add the chicken o the pan and continue to sauté for 2-3 minutes until sealed and lightly golden, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon.

Stir in the curry paste, garlic and ginger until everything is coated. Add the seeds, carrots and turnip with the stock and bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook for 10-15 minutes until the chicken and vegetables are just tender.

499fffaa-85fc-5dd4-bfad-905b80e9c04b.title: Turkey rogan josh

50d86508-0d37-575e-9195-0a8995ff8849.title: Moroccan vegetable tagine

5138e7c3-e4fb-542d-bfdf-45e0826e4a46.title: Chicken biryani

545cf91e-867c-5a9b-b2b5-76e8eb7cf1b5.title: Green risotto

585cc494-f521-5961-adf9-1b39060937a1.title: Hot cross buns
instructions: Warm the water and milk in a microwave or saucepan. It should be warm to touch, not hot. Water that is too hot will kill the yeast cultures instead of activating them

Mix eggs by hand in a separate bowl then add them into the blend

ESSRG_8.title: Mushroom stew with cooked potatoes and parsley
instructions: Mushroom stew: Heat the sunflower oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until soft and lightly golden.
Remove the pan briefly from the heat and stir in the paprika to prevent burning, then return to the heat. Add the chopped mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Stir in the chopped tomatoes and yellow pepper, then season with salt. Cook gently until the vegetables are tender and the stew has thickened slightly.
Serve hot with bread or Hungarian dumplings
Cooked potatoes with parsley: Diced and cooked potatoes, mixed with salt, margarine and parsley

benefit.tip: Low-sodium salt: the dish has 66% less salt per serving.

ESSRG_81.title: Green pea pottage with garlic bread

Garlic bread: Toasted baguette, rubbed with raw garlic

ESSRG_83.title: Roasted veggie soup with toasted chickpeas and croutons
instructions: Roasted veggie soup: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Roast the red and yellow peppers, tomatoes, and courgette until soft and lightly charred. Let them cool slightly, then remove any tough skins if needed. Transfer the roasted vegetables to a blender. Add the cashew nuts, yeast extract, salt, and black pepper. Blend until smooth and creamy, adding a little water if needed to reach your desired soup consistency. Pour into a pot and gently reheat if necessary before serving.

Croutons: Preheat the oven to 180°C (or air fryer to 170–180°C). Cut stale bread into small cubes and spread them in a single layer on a baking tray or in the air fryer basket. Bake or air fry for 8–12 minutes, shaking or tossing halfway through, until the bread is golden and crisp. While still warm, sprinkle with flaky salt and fresh chopped herbs. Let cool slightly before serving so they become fully crisp.

Crispy chickpeas: Toss drained and thoroughly dried chickpeas with a little oil and your chosen seasonings (such as salt, paprika, garlic powder, or cumin). Spread the chickpeas in a single layer and air fry until golden and crispy, shaking the basket occasionally for even cooking.

benefit.tip: Low sodium salt: the Nutri-Score improves from B to A and the dish has 36% less salt per serving.

ESSRG_85.title: Vegetables in breadcrumbs with corn rice
instructions: Deep-fried egetables in breadcrumbs: Cut the mushrooms, broccoli, and courgette into bite-sized pieces. Lightly salt the vegetables and let them sit for about 10–15 minutes so they release excess moisture. Then pat them dry thoroughly before coating. Prepare a batter by mixing the flour with soy milk and a pinch of salt until smooth. Separately, blend or crush the toasted bread into fine breadcrumbs. Dip the vegetables first into the batter, then coat evenly in breadcrumbs. Heat sunflower oil in a deep pan to about 170–180°C. Fry in batches until golden and crispy. Remove and drain on paper towels, season if needed, and serve hot.

Sweetcorn rice: Rinse the white rice under cold water until the water runs clear. Add it to a saucepan with fresh water (about 1 part rice to 2 parts water) and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid, and simmer gently for about 10–15 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender. Remove from the heat and let it sit, still covered, for 5–10 minutes. Fluff with a fork, then mix in the drained canned sweetcorn while the rice is still warm and serve.

benefit.tip: Wholemeal bread and low-sodium salt keep the dish just as hearty while the Nutri-Score improves from B to A and the dish has 58% less salt per serving.

ESSRG_88.title: Chickpea wrap
instructions: Chickpea wrap: Mashed chickpeas and avocado, diced red onions and tomatoes with rocket salad, wrapped in a whole wheat tortilla

benefit.tip: Using a wholemeal wrap: the dish has 46% less salt per serving.

ESSRG_89.title: Stuffed peppers, vegan
instructions: Stuffed peppers, vegan: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Cut the tops off the red bell peppers and remove the seeds.

In a bowl, mix the cooked basmati rice with the canned, rinsed kidney beans, sweetcorn and chopped canned tomatoes, and finely chopped red chili. Season with salt and spices (such as cumin or chili if desired) and stir until well combined.

Fill the peppers with the mixture and place them in a baking dish. Add a small splash of water to the bottom of the dish to help them steam. Cover with foil and bake for about 30–40 minutes, then uncover and bake for another 10 minutes until the peppers are soft and slightly roasted. Serve warm.

benefit.tip: Low-sodium salt: the dish has 72% less salt per serving.

ESSRG_9.title: Chicken breast in breadcrumb with steamed vegetables and white rice
instructions: Chicken breast in breadcrumb: Cut or flatten the chicken breast into even pieces if needed. Coat each piece first in flour, then dip into beaten egg, then cover thoroughly in breadcrumbs, pressing gently so the coating sticks well.
Heat oil to about 180°C in a deep pan or fryer. Carefully deep-fry the breaded chicken until golden brown and crisp on the outside and fully cooked inside.
Remove and drain on paper towels. Serve hot or in a sandwich as a leftover.

Steamed carrot and peas: Bring a small pot of water to a boil and place a steamer basket over it. Add the sliced carrots and steam for about 3–4 minutes until they begin to soften. Add the peas and continue steaming for another 2–3 minutes, until both vegetables are tender but still bright in colour.

Steamed white rice: Rinse the white rice under cold water until the water runs clear. Add it to a saucepan with fresh water (about 1 part rice to 2 parts water) and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid, and simmer gently for about 10–15 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender. Remove from the heat and let it sit, still covered, for 5–10 minutes.

benefit.tip: Brown rice and low-sodium salt keep the dish just as hearty while the dish has 36% more fibre per serving.

ESSRG_90.title: Layered cauliflower casserole, vegan

ingredient_lines.old: 25 g Rice, white, long grain, raw

instructions: Layered cauliflower casserole, vegan: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Toss the cauliflower florets with sunflower oil and spread them on a baking tray. Roast for about 15 minutes, until lightly golden and tender.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in salted water until tender.

Heat a pan over medium heat and sauté the chopped onion until soft. Add the paprika and stir briefly, then add the chopped tomatoes and cook for about 5 minutes. Crumble or finely dice the tofu and add it to the pan. Cook for a few minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tofu is heated through and has absorbed the flavours of the tomato and paprika mixture, creating a tofu ragout.

To assemble the casserole, spread half of the roasted cauliflower in the bottom of a baking dish. Add the cooked rice in an even layer, then spread the tofu ragout over the rice. Top with the remaining cauliflower and finish with a layer of plant-based cream.
Bake for 15–20 minutes at 180°C, until heated through and lightly golden on top. Let it rest for a few minutes before serving.

benefit.tip: Using brown rice and less oil: the dish has 10% less saturated fat per serving.

ESSRG_91.title: Cabbage pasta

ESSRG_92.title: Potato pasta with pickled beetroot

Pickled beetroot: store-bought

ESSRG_93.title: Fussili with green pesto, courgettes and chickpeas
instructions: Fusilli with green pesto, courgettes and chickpeas: Cook the fusilli in boiling salted water according to package instructions until al dente, then drain, reserving a small amount of the cooking water.
Meanwhile, roast or sauté the courgette until tender and lightly golden. Warm the rinsed and drained chickpeas in a pan or add them directly.

Combine the hot pasta with the green pesto, adding a splash of the reserved pasta water if needed to create a silky sauce. Fold in the courgette and chickpeas, toss until evenly coated, and serve warm. Finish with a generous sprinkle of nutritional yeast on top.

benefit.tip: Using less pesto: the dish has 16% less saturated fat per serving.

ESSRG_94.title: Red lentil pottage with potatoes, topped with pumpkin seeds
instructions: Red lentil pottage: Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat and sauté the chopped onion until soft and lightly golden. Add the minced garlic, turmeric, and paprika, and cook briefly until fragrant.

Stir in the rinsed red lentils and add enough water or vegetable stock to cover generously, bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer. After 20 minutes, add the diced potatoes, carrots, and  cook until the lentils have broken down completely and the vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally and adding more liquid if needed. Season with salt and black pepper, then serve warm as a thick, comforting pottage.
Pumpkin seed: store-bought

benefit.tip: Using low-sodium salt and less olive oil: the dish has 73% less salt per serving.

ESSRG_95.title: Spinach pottage with potatoes
instructions: Spinach pottage: Heat the sunflower oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until soft and lightly golden, then stir in the garlic and cook briefly until fragrant.

Add the frozen spinach cubes and cook until fully thawed and softened, stirring occasionally. Once the spinach has released and cooked down, pour in the milk and heat the mixture through for a few minutes.

For the thickening, mix the flour with a small amount of cold milk in a separate bowl until completely smooth. Take a few spoonfuls of the hot spinach mixture and slowly whisk it into the flour slurry to equalise the temperature. Then pour this tempered mixture back into the pot while stirring continuously.
Cook gently for a few more minutes until the pottage thickens to a smooth, creamy consistency. Season with salt and serve warm.
Cooked potatoes with parsley: Diced and cooked potatoes, mixed with salt, margarine and parsley

benefit.tip: Low-sodium salt: the Nutri-Score improves from B to A and the dish has 63% less salt per serving.

ESSRG_96.title: Vegan bolognese spaghetti
instructions: Vegan bolognese spaghetti: Heat the sunflower oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery, and sauté until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook briefly until fragrant.
Add the lentils, bay leaf, oregano, and enough water to just cover. Bring to a simmer and cook until the lentils are almost tender, stirring occasionally and adding a little more water if needed.
Stir in the canned tomatoes and continue cooking for about 10 minutes, until the sauce thickens and the lentils are fully cooked. Remove the bay leaf, adjust seasoning, and serve with spaghetti.

benefit.tip: Using less sunflower oil: the dish has 19% less saturated fat per serving.

ESSRG_97.title: Oven baked vegetables and tofu with tahini dressing
instructions: Oven baked vegetables and tofu: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Cut the Jerusalem artichokes, beetroot, carrots, cabbage, and tofu into bite-sized pieces. Toss everything with rapeseed oil and spread in a single layer on a baking tray.
Roast for 25–35 minutes, turning halfway through, until the vegetables are tender and lightly caramelised and the tofu is golden at the edges.
Transfer to a serving dish and finish with a drizzle of tahini dressing before serving.

Tahini dressing: Mix the tahini paste with lemon juice until it thickens and becomes smooth. Add garlic powder, salt, and finely chopped fresh parsley, then stir to combine. Gradually add a little water to loosen the dressing until it reaches a creamy, pourable consistency. Adjust seasoning to taste and serve.

benefit.tip: Using low-sodium salt and less oil: the dish has 65% less salt per serving.

ESSRG_98.title: Green pea soup; Poppy seed pasta

ingredient_lines.new: 10 g Stock cube, vegetable, reduced salt

instructions: Green pea soup: Heat the sunflower oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the diced carrot and parsnip and sauté for a few minutes until they start to soften. Add the frozen peas and stir well, then pour in enough water to cover the vegetables, and add a whole onion (peeled, but left intact). Crumble in the vegetable stock cube and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer until all the vegetables are tender and the flavours have combined. Season if needed and serve hot.

Poppy seed pasta: Cook the wide egg noodles (szélesmetélt) in boiling salted water according to package instructions until al dente, then drain well. In a dry pan, lightly toast the poppy seeds for a few seconds until fragrant, taking care not to burn them. Toss the hot noodles with the poppy seeds and sugar until evenly coated. Serve warm.

benefit.tip: Using less oil and sugar, and a reduced-salt stock cube: the Nutri-Score improves from B to A and the dish has 26% less salt per serving.

ESSRG_99.title: Hungarian ratatuille with eggs and bread
instructions: Hungarian ratatuille with eggs: Heat the sunflower oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and cook until soft and lightly golden. Stir in the cumin seeds and paprika, then add the sliced peppers and cook for a few minutes until they begin to soften. Add the chopped tomatoes and salt, mix well, and simmer gently until the vegetables are tender and the flavours have combined.
Pour in the whisked eggs and stir continuously through the hot vegetable mixture until the eggs are fully cooked and set. Cook until creamy and evenly combined, then serve immediately.
Sourdough bread: store-bought

benefit.tip: Using low-sodium salt and less oil: the dish has 45% less salt per serving.

a09dc4ce-1bee-5d75-a11f-c2b139f5d79b.title: Granny Bríd's chicken
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C/ 250°F/ Gas Mark 4.

Peel the potatoes and using a small sharp knife, cut them into 2.5cm cubes. Place them in a pan of boiling water and add a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 6-8 minutes until tender.

Drain the potatoes into a colander and then spread on to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Drizzle the olive oil, tossing the potato cubes until evenly coated. Roast on the middle shelf of the oven for 25-30 minutes until cooked through and golden brown, turning them once to ensure they cook evenly.
Heat a large non-stick frying pan over a medium heat.
Cut the chicken into small dices, discarding any skin. Add to the heated pan and cook for a few minutes until they star to release their fat.
Cut the chicken into 2.5cm strips with a small sharp knife and add to the sizzling chicken, tossing to coat and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until cooked through and lightly browned.
Remember to wash your hands and work surface with warm, soapy water after handling raw meat.
Sprinkle over the paprika and smoked paprika into the chicken and chicken and stir to coat. Cook for another minute, then pour in the cooking cream and allow to bubble down. Keep warm.

Cut the pepper in half and remove any seeds, then thinly slice and stir into the chicken mixture until evenly combined. Arrange on plates with the roast potatoes and scatter over the parsley to serve.

benefit.tip: Chicken meat: the dish has 84% less salt per serving.

a0a7fc4a-561f-5495-bcab-344a8cb0bb81.title: Pea soup with bacon
instructions: Heat the oil in a saucepan over a medium heat
Add the garlic and onion, cooking until they soften
Stir to avoid them going brown and sticking to the pan
Add the water, stock cube, peas, mint and parsley
Bring to the boil and then reduce the heat, cooking the mixture through for 8 minutes
Remove from the heat and leave for a few minutes until the pan cools
Get a food blender or processor and whiz the soup mix until smooth
Trim the rashers of any fat and grill them until they go crispy and crumble up
When the soup is ready, pour it into bowls and serve with the pepper and rashers on top

benefit.tip: Using less oil and reduced-salt stock: the dish has 18% less salt per serving.

a1206962-747e-59e6-95bd-2d3d742ec088.title: Wholemeal scones
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C / 350°F / Gas mark 4
Sieve the plain flour and baking powder into a large mixing bowl
Mix in the wholemeal flour
Cut the margarine into small cubes
Rub this into the flour mix with your fingers until the mix is powdery
Mix in the sugar, then add enough milk to make a dough
Place the dough on a worktop that’s been dusted with flour, so it won’t stick
Bring the mix together with the hands until it is smooth (don’t knead the dough)
Divide into 6 equal balls of dough
Pat the dough balls into round 3cm thick patties
Transfer to a baking tray and bake for 15 minutes
When baked transfer to a cooling rack and allow to cool
Serve and eat as soon as possible

benefit.tip: Reducing the sugar: the dish has 19% less sugar per serving.

a2b11a0f-4b24-56b1-a132-2854d818d21a.title: Porridge
instructions: Put all ingredients in a saucepan and gradually bring it to the boil.
Then turn the heat down and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes.
Stir occasionally until it is a creamy texture.
If it gets too thick, add a little more semi-skimmed milk or water.
Add your favourite topping like fruit, seeds or nuts.

benefit.tip: Switching to skimmed milk: the dish has 72% less saturated fat per serving.

a2bd0ae8-4cb2-56ec-a276-c2d5b65c33cf.title: Baked oat bars
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C/400°F/Gas Mark 6.
Line a 20cm square baking tin with baking paper.
Place the oats, seeds, and lemon zest in a mixing bowl. Stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, mix the milk, eggs, and golden syrup.
Add the wet mixture to the oats and stir until just combined.
Add the blueberries and stir gently, taking care not to burst if using the fresh blueberries.
Transfer to the lined baking tin and bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown on top.
Once cool enough to handle, remove baking paper and place on a chopping board, cut into 12 squares.
Can be enjoyed warm or cold.

a3a30e86-8d42-569d-a35e-df7f97c81302.title: Super easy Sunday roast chicken

instructions: Remove the chicken from the fridge and cut into slices, then arrange on two plates. Set aside at room temperature until needed.

Meanwhile, peel the carrots and cut into thin slices. Steam the carrots along with the peas until they are tender.
Meanwhile, mash the potatoes using a potato masher then beat in the butter and milk with a wooden spoon until light and fluffy. Season lightly with salt and pepper.

Make up the gravy granules according to packet instructions in a small pan on the hob.
Check that the vegetables are cooked and if they are, take the chicken and mashed potatoes out of the oven with oven gloves and tip on the carrots and peas. Pour over the gravy and serve at once.

a81e35b3-b3c4-5157-a221-ac57339f880e.title: Brussels Sprouts with Honey and Mustard

a881047f-68d7-5bed-a345-5237e98ed5b6.title: Stephen McAllister's thai chilli chicken

a9d5e020-c739-5d5f-9605-b82dde40fdb4.title: Honey roast ham
instructions: Allow 20 minutes of cooking time per 450g / 1lb.
Remove the outer wrappings and place ham in a saucepan. Cover with cold water, place the lid on top and bring to the boil.

aad29733-7432-4436-b9d9-326b23c7396d.title: Herb soup

ab2fc20a-a84f-4b8f-acc9-e72dc2784fbb.title: Fried bread slices

ac9dd146-c2bf-5b21-83c4-b851c2953375.title: Mushroom and courgette tagliatelle
instructions: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over a medium-hot heat and when hot add the mushrooms with a twist of black pepper until brown.

Turn the heat down to medium and add the scallions and garlic and cook for 1 minute before adding the courgette and dried thyme and chilli.

Return the mushrooms to the pan with the cooked courgette, add the walnuts and drained pasta and mix well.

acd3172c-2e81-5f3e-b9ec-3241d23a7770.title: Vegetable paella

ingredient_lines.new: ¼ reduced-salt vegetable stock cube, dissolved in 300ml / 10½fl oz. of boiling water

Once the rice and vegetables are coated well in the paprika add the flavoured stock, including the bay leaf.
Bring to the boil before turning down the heat, covering with a lid and simmer until everything is cooked and the rice has absorbed most of the water, about 15 minutes.
Next add the peas and if it looks too dry, add up to 50ml more of boiling water at the same stage, before simmering for a 5 minutes.
Once everything is cooked, season with the pepper and lemon juice and serve garnished with the chopped parsley.

benefit.tip: Using reduced-salt stock and less olive oil: the dish has 19% less salt per serving.

af96c8e8-ce13-49d3-9337-06a0fbb15b57.title: Fish goulash
instructions: Sauté onion, peppers, celery, parsley, and garlic in oil about 10 minutes. Add tomato paste, fish stock, and bay leaf; simmer 20 minutes. Add fish pieces and cook until done. Season with chili, salt, and pepper.

benefit.tip: Using less olive oil: the dish has 18% less saturated fat per serving.

b00c8b2a-a8d4-5782-ba90-6ffdc591be03.title: Sweet potato satay stew
instructions: Peel and chop the onion, garlic and ginger.

Add in the chopped sweet potato and mix well.
Add the passata and the stock. Bring to the boil, cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the potatoes are almost tender.
Add the spinach and cook for a further 5 minutes.
Mix a few spoonfuls of the stew juices with the peanut butter to soften it and then mix it all back into the stew.
Season with black pepper and garnish with chopped coriander.

benefit.tip: Using less peanut butter and oil: the dish has 27% less saturated fat per serving.

b1a62f7e-8407-4005-a024-a125172e9add.title: Beef in horseradish sauce
instructions: Slice cooked beef. Mix stock, sour cream, flour, and vinegar and bring to a boil. Add grated parmesan, salt, and pepper; cool slightly, add yolk and mix. Grease a pan, arrange beef, pour over sauce, sprinkle parmesan, and bake 10 minutes.

benefit.tip: Cottage cheese: the Nutri-Score improves from D to C and the dish has 27% less saturated fat per serving.

b533c99b-b2a1-47c6-a185-351f81e7b83e.title: Potato goulash
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut small. Sauté onion in oil, add paprika and potatoes, season with salt, pepper, caraway, and bay leaf, and fry until potatoes dry out. Add boiling water and stew. Add parsley at the end.

benefit.tip: Using less oil: the dish has 23% less saturated fat per serving.

b56223b3-42d9-51b1-a320-5c5a9e417718.title: Chicken and pasta salad
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C / 400°F / Gas Mark 6.

b65d06fa-fffa-5e67-abfa-313876a52f98.title: Nutty fried rice with satay sauce
instructions: Rinse the rice well in a sieve and then add to a pan of 250ml of water. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and cover with a lid. Simmer for 25 minutes, then turn off the heat and leave to sit for another 10 minutes for perfectly cooked rice.
Spread the rice out on a tray and allow to cool to prevent further cooking.
To make the satay sauce, mix two teaspoons of soy sauce in a small bowl with the peanut butter, vinegar, one tablespoon of water and the seasame seeds, if using. Set aside until needed.
Break off the broccoli florets. Trim the mushrooms and cut into slices.
Heat a wok or large non-stick pan over a medium heat. Dry roast the cashew nuts, tossing regularly until evenly coloured. Tip on the chopping board and once cooled, roughly chopped.
Add one teaspoon of the oil to the wok and swirl up the sides, then tip in the broccoli and mushrooms and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until tender. Tip on a plate and set aside.

b68a8fc1-ef8e-47f6-8f1c-8db6789d0f15.title: Viennese schnitzel
instructions: Wash the schnitzels and dry well with paper towels. Pound them on both sides and season with salt. Let rest 5 minutes. Meanwhile beat the eggs in a deep plate. Heat oil in a deep pan and fry the schnitzels 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

benefit.tip: Using less oil: the dish has 12% less saturated fat per serving.

b845c6dd-22b4-4690-bcb0-25a4083a51ad.title: Idrija dumplings (žlikrofi), boiled

b86ea4ab-4283-52d2-a598-4c92a770f701.title: Greek pasta salad

Halve the cucumber and cut into thick slices
Place the pasta, cucumber, red onion, tomatoes, crumbled feta cheese olives and dressing in a bowl and gently mix, then serve.

b9c6b8be-4b41-4978-ac0c-1ae683ab4b78.title: Pasta with cabbage

bacdb571-372a-5aa0-8a80-3e6ff2843da9.title: Sweet potato crisps

bca5fc34-a0b6-423a-8492-5b5dde42179c.title: Slovenian rolled cake (potica) with walnuts
instructions: Potica dough: Put the flour in a bowl and add salt. In one cup dissolve the yeast in water or milk; in another cup whisk the egg yolks with the sugar. Warm the milk and melt the butter. Add the hot milk to the flour, mix, then add the yolk–sugar mixture. Mix again, add the dissolved yeast and butter, and knead into a medium-soft dough. Knead until elastic on the inside and smooth on the outside. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise at room temperature until doubled. Knead once more. Filling: Mix lukewarm milk, walnuts, sugar, eggs, cinnamon, and lemon zest. Spread on the rolled-out dough. The filling should be the same temperature as the dough. Roll up tightly, place in a mold, prick it, and let rise. Bake 50 minutes at 190°C.

bcb33fed-9cd5-4075-9ab2-4e6ae9b5b0bc.title: Banana bread

benefit.tip: Using less sugar and low-sodium salt: the dish has 19% less sugar per serving.

bdb5b7cf-1f4e-5b22-88b4-9866c9c464db.title: Homemade oven chips
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 200ºC/400ºF/Gas Mark 6

bebfea79-d65e-52a3-b4ea-ab89fea0cc29.title: Turkey in barbecue sauce
instructions: Pre-heat the oven to 190°C / 375°F / Gas Mark 5

Spoon sauce over the turkey
Cover and bake for 55 to 60 minutes, until the turkey is tender

bfb276ad-0ce0-4b34-85bb-aed467362068.title: Potato salad with onion

c1f80d7d-3498-5a15-bd4d-98680b8e6a05.title: Vegetable stir-fry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C / 400°F / Gas Mark 6.
Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Place the vegetables, apart from the onion on a baking tray and roast until tender for about 20 minutes.
Fry the onion gently without browning it in a wok or large pan. Set aside ½ of it for later.

benefit.tip: Brown rice: the dish has 29% more fibre per serving.

c2216aee-cc8d-4385-beb5-0d6b367388ac.title: Prekmurje gibanica layered pastry
instructions: Prekmurje gibanica is made with two doughs: shortcrust for the base and stretched (strudel/phyllo) dough. Line the pan with shortcrust (firmer because the cake is heavy). Make shortcrust from flour, butter, egg, cream, salt, and sugar; rest 30 minutes. Prepare stretched dough from flour, egg, oil, lemon juice, lukewarm water, and salt; rest 30 minutes, divide into small balls. Prepare fillings: – Poppy seed: ground poppy with boiling milk, sugar, vanilla sugar. – Cottage cheese: cottage cheese with egg, cream, rinsed raisins, sugar. – Walnut: ground walnuts with boiling milk, sugar, cinnamon; spreadable. – Apple: peeled thin slices fried with sugar until almost soft, cinnamon, lemon zest. Roll shortcrust and place in greased pan. Stretch strudel dough on a floured cloth, let dry slightly. Assemble layers: poppy filling(~1 cm), a sheet of dough brushed with butter; cottage cheese filling, dough sheet with butter; walnut filling, dough sheet with butter; apple filling, dough sheet with butter; repeat with all fillings, top with 1–2 dough sheets, butter, and pour over cream. Bake about 1 hour at moderate temperature.

benefit.tip: Reducing the sugar: the dish has 16% less sugar per serving.

c27313a6-9649-42d8-9d67-4dc60379d7d6.title: Buckwheat žganci with melted butter

c532f51e-3ad6-4c53-9674-4362465d0b51.title: Buckwheat pocket
instructions: Pour boiling salted water over buckwheat flour, mix, cool, then add wheat flour and knead smooth. Roll into a circle and place in a pan. Mix cottage cheese, Greek yoghurt, egg, and sugar, spread on dough, and bake at 200°C until golden.

c59aa820-1f78-4f43-99c1-171139a4b15a.title: Deaf štruklji

benefit.tip: Using less butter: the dish has 22% less saturated fat per serving.

ca09c6c5-2859-5f03-b838-67828e34a48d.title: Pancakes

cb905240-1415-5df9-837b-473483f576ec.title: Tuna pasta with sweetcorn and peppers
instructions: Cook the pasta in a pan of boiling water for 10-12 minutes or according to packet instructions.

cca9d9a5-76e1-51b9-8efc-49e83ec0a24b.title: Spinach and feta frittata

cecbc1db-4f37-5424-81fb-f3cc8f4e9911.title: Chicken Caesar salad

cf95fb67-86b4-4a65-bcdc-00d918cbd728.title: Potato with mangold

ingredient_lines.new: 38g of sugar plus 1 dessertspoon for topping

d8e2c4ab-656e-47a7-9114-6db4373d3e73.title: Flat meatballs

da9bb460-3acb-5246-b670-35853dc5132c.title: Aoife's shepherd's pie
instructions: Using a small sharp knife, peel and chop the onions, carrots and celery. Peel the garlic and use a garlic rusher or grate on the fine side of a box grater.

dd1d5c94-c035-5c1a-9618-8c9ff46ded2e.title: Minestrone soup with bacon
instructions: Gently heat a tablespoon of oil in a large saucepan

e53deb30-2230-57a3-b9fb-63e32401229f.title: Turkey and butternut squash curry

benefit.tip: Barley: the dish has 1% less calories per serving.

e9e84e5c-3d2f-5fa9-80e4-8bc090214ac2.title: Pasta with courgette, olive oil, garlic and chilli
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil making sure the handle of the pot is not over the edge of the cooker or other rings.
Slowly add the pasta to the water. Stir occasionally to prevent from sticking together.
Follow the instructions on the pasta packet for cooking time, then strain and pour into a serving bowl.
Heat 1 ½ teaspoons of olive oil in a small frying pan and add the courgette, garlic, chilli, and season with black pepper.
Cook at medium heat for about two minutes to infuse the flavours into the oil.
Mix into the pasta, garnish with fresh parsley or basil and serve immediately.

benefit.tip: Wholewheat pasta: the dish has 219% more fibre per serving.

e9fb7b9c-78b7-5cd2-806f-43c0d2bcce60.title: Pea risotto
instructions: Heat the oil in a medium sized saucepan and gently cook the onion and garlic until soft
Add the rice and stir, making sure it soaks up the oil and flavours
Boil the water in a kettle
Gradually add the water until it covers the rice
Crumble in a good quality vegetable stock cube
Keep stirring until the rice has absorbed all the liquid
Add some more water and repeat
Add the peas and keep cooking until the rice is soft but not mushy. The rice should still have a kind of sauce around it
Sprinkle some cheese on top and mix in to the rice
Serve immediately

benefit.tip: Using reduced-salt stock: the dish has 18% less salt per serving.

ea4cd06b-d3fb-5fe2-8fd8-e62bf5bbb779.title: Neven Maguire's turkey, ham and potato pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C / 425°F / Gas Mark 7
Heat a large frying pan, melt the butter and oil, and then add the sliced onion and leeks. Cover and cook very gently
After 5 minutes, add the cubed potatoes and cook for a further 10 minutes until the onion, leeks and potatoes are soft
Stir in the flour, turn up the heat, then gradually add the stock, stirring until the mix thickens a little.
Take off the heat, then stir in the crème fraîche, mustard and add the cooked turkey and ham
Season to taste, then cool - if you have time
Spoon the mix into a large pie dish, add a bay leaf and the chopped parsley (this mix can be made up to a day ahead and kept chilled)
Trim pastry to fit the top of the dish and brush around the edges with a little water to help it stick, then press down along the sides to seal
Cut a few slits to let the steam escape, then brush all over the top with beaten egg. Bake for 30 minutes until risen

benefit.tip: Using creme fraiche half fat: the dish has 15% less saturated fat per serving.

eafb2509-1fcf-5348-97e8-ddcd110ebbbc.title: Chicken goujons with potato wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C/ 400°F/ Gas Mark 6.
Using a small knife, cut the potatoes into evenly-sized wedges. Place in a pan of boiling water and cook for 3-4 minutes until almost tender but still holding their shape.

Arrange the wedges on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and drizzle with the olive oil, tossing to coat. Season lightly with salt if you desire and put on the top shelf of the oven to roast for 25 minutes until cooked through and golden brown. Turn them over half way through to ensure they cook evenly.

Meanwhile, put the flour in a shallow dish and seasonly lightly with salt and black pepper. Break the egg into a separate bowl and add the milk, then beat to combine with a fork. Mix the breadcrumbs and oats in a separate bowl and line the three bowls up alongside each other with an empty plate ready for the coated chicken.

Using a small sharp knife or scissors, cut the chicken into strips. In small batches of 2-3 pieces, toss the chicken strips in the flour and toss to coat, shaking off any excess. Dip in the beaten egg mixture and then roll on the breadcrumbs. Put on the plate while you repeat with the remaining chicken.
Remember to wash your hands and work surface with warm soapy water after handling raw chicken.
Arrange the chicken goujons on a separate baking sheet lined with parchment paper and the remaining olive oil. Place in the oven and cook for 15-20 minutes until cooked through and tender.
Arrange the chicken goujons on plates with the potato wedges and arrange the lettuce with cherry tomatoes that you've cut in half alongside to serve.

benefit.tip: Using less olive oil and skinless chicken fillets: the dish has 44% less saturated fat per serving.

ed9b8c65-ac00-55a9-817f-1d461cd4d1bf.title: Thai butternut squash curry
instructions: Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan
When hot, add the curry paste, garlic, ginger, onions and red pepper and cook for 10 minutes until the vegetables are soft
Add the butternut squash and water, bring to the boil before turning down the heat to low and simmering for 20 minutes
After the curry has simmered for 20 minutes, add the coconut milk and chickpeas and cook for a further 5 to 10 minutes
Cook the rice as per the pack instructions (60g portion per person)
Add the lime juice and coriander just before serving with the rice

benefit.tip: Brown rice and boiled chickpeas keep the dish just as hearty while the Nutri-Score improves from B to A and the dish has 42% less salt per serving.

eee2cf94-9b4a-56bd-adb0-81c38999e90e.title: Ultimate basic muffins

ingredient_lines.new: ¾ teaspoon Salt low sodium LoSalt

instructions: Heat oven to 180°C fan or Gas Mark 6.
Line 2 muffin trays with paper muffin cases.
Beat the eggs lightly with a wooden spoon for about one minute.
Add the oil and the milk and beat until mixed.
Add the sugar and mix until you have a smooth batter.
Sift in the flour and salt and mix until smooth. Don't over mix.
At this stage, gently mix in whatever other ingredients you decide to use - or you can just leave them plain.
Fill muffin cases two-thirds full and bake for 20-25 minutes, until they are risen.
Cool on a wire tray.

benefit.tip: Using low-sodium salt and less sugar: the dish has 35% less salt per serving.

f1bf9389-64a5-59a4-8cd2-644c4265a555.title: Scotch broth
instructions: Brown the meat in a frying pan with the oil
Chop all the other vegetables; onions, carrots, turnip, leeks, garlic
Add 2 litres / 4 pints of cold water to large cooking pot and put in the meats, and the scrapings off their pan, before adding the chopped vegetables, herbs, and stock cube
Bring slowly to the boil, and then skim off excess fat
Simmer for 4 to 5 hours, allow cooling, then skimming again, and take out the herb bouquet
Check seasoning and serve steaming hot

benefit.tip: Lean braising steak: the dish has 43% less saturated fat per serving.

f4da5282-8e10-555a-80e8-0ce75eee8db5.title: Vegetables provencal
instructions: Chop all vegetables
Add the onions, leeks, garlic, peppers and courgettes to a large heated saucepan
Add the tomatoes, puree and ketchup and mix well
Rinse and drain the chick peas and add to the pan
Cover, bring to the boil and then simmer gently for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally until cooked
Remove the lid and increase heat for 10 minutes
Stir in the olives and herbs, then season with black pepper

benefit.tip: Using reduced-sugar ketchup: the dish has 22% less salt per serving.

f57c9035-fa26-5638-ae22-7fa0a063f0ad.title: Spicy Christmas biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 180°C / 350°F / Gas Mark 4
Weigh out flour and sieve on to a plate
Weigh out margarine and sugar and place in a large mixing bowl
Add cinnamon and nutmeg and beat together till smooth and creamy
Add sieved flour, one tablespoon at a time and mix until all the flour is incorporated. Use your hands to get the dough to come together into a ball
Place the ball of dough on a floured worktop and flatten slightly. Roll it out to about 1 cm / ½ inch thick
Cut shapes with cookie cutters – this is especially nice if you can find star or holly shaped cutters
Place the cookies on a greased baking tray and bake for 10 to 15 minutes until a very pale golden
Remove from baking tray on to a cooling rack and sprinkle with a little more castor sugar. Cool completely and store in an airtight tin

benefit.tip: Using wholemeal flour and reducing sugar: the dish has 23% less sugar per serving.

f9b3888c-d870-5452-b5bf-df638d75f72a.title: Apricot loaf
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150⁰C / 300⁰F / Gas mark 2
Grease a 500g loaf tin and line with greaseproof paper
Place the apricots, raisins, water, sugar and margarine into a saucepan
Simmer for 4 minutes and then allow to cool
Add the flour and baking powder and mix, if the mixture is too dry add a little more water at this point
Pour mixture into the loaf tin and bake for 1 to 1½ hours
Test if the loaf is cooked by inserting a skewer into the center, it should come out clean

benefit.tip: Using half wholemeal flour and less sugar: the dish has 4% less sugar per serving.

fc7a299f-ddb2-575c-8048-cecd1d78cbbb.title: Brussels sprouts with apple and red onion
instructions: Wash the sprouts thoroughly, making sure that there is no dirt under the leaves
Place the Brussels sprouts in a steamer and steam until the sprouts are tender but still have some resistance when poked with a fork
While the sprouts are cooking, heat the olive oil in a large frying pan
Make the stock by dissolving the stock cube in boiling water
Cook the onion in the oil until the onion becomes translucent and carmelized
Pour the vegetable stock and wine over the red onions and allow the mix to reduce down to half its original volume, and then remove from the heat

Put the sliced apples in to a bowl with some lemon juice so that it keeps is colour and doesn’t brown. You can add these in to the steamer for a minute or two or just add in to the mixture without warming through
Put the sprouts in a serving bowl. Pour your reduced onion mixture and apples over the sprouts, and mix well
Season with pepper, to taste

benefit.tip: Using reduced-salt stock and less olive oil: the dish has 25% less salt per serving.

fd653d65-0188-4030-9397-0e8d2cb1cf7a.title: Risotto with peas

ingredient_lines.old: 6g Salt, white (sea, igneous or rock), iodine added, no fluride added

instructions: Cook the peas. Heat oil in a pot, add rice and fry a few minutes, then add boiling water and salt. When it boils, cover and simmer on low heat until tender. Do not stir. Mix the cooked rice and peas. Serve with chopped parsley.

benefit.tip: Low sodium salt: the Nutri-Score improves from B to A and the dish has 64% less salt per serving.

ff5eeb2e-2d46-47da-8834-c4061a15f9db.title: Potato žganci
instructions: Peel, slice and half-cook potatoes in salted water. Add flour and cook 30 minutes more. Drain, mix well, crumble into potato žganci, and dress with cracklings.

benefit.tip: Using canola oil instead of lard: the Nutri-Score improves from B to A and the dish has 83% less saturated fat per serving.

ffbea373-7cff-5335-9a7b-8806a26e9b95.title: Quick and easy blueberry muffins
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C / 400°F / Gas Mark 6.
Line a muffin tin with cases.
In a large bowl, mix the low-fat spread, sugar, eggs, and yoghurt until combined.
Add the flour and stir until just combined.
Add the blueberries and stir through gently, taking care not to break up the blueberries.
Divide the mixture between the muffin cases and bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes until the muffins are golden.

benefit.tip: Using less brown sugar: the dish has 19% less sugar per serving.
